entries:
In Path of Exile, all of your skills (other than your default attack) come from items called 'skill gems'. Skill gems must be socketed into your equipped weapons and armour in order for you to be able to use the skill they grant. It doesn't matter which item the gem is socketed into, but the socket has to match the colour of the gem. In other words, red skill gems can go in red sockets, and can't go in blue or green sockets.

Support gems work very similarly to skill gems, except they don't grant you a skill by themselves. Instead, support gems can augment the skill gems they are linked to. Not all skill and support gems work together; You can't use a 'Melee Physical Damage Support' with a spell, for example.

Allflame Capsules can be used to send loot back up to Valerie, aboard the Sovereign. Loot sent to the surface can be safely claimed at any time, so long as you have not begin another Voyage.

Capsules are also used to call in the Bathysphere, to safely extract from a Voyage in progress.

Allflame crafting is a powerful tool that can be used to magnify the efficiency of your currency.

Place an item and a currency that is valid to apply that item into the crafting window. Assuming you can pay the cost of [DeadMansSulphur|Dead Man's Sulphur], you will be allowed to perform the craft which the placed currency would usually do to that item. However, instead of just one outcome you will instead create multiple [GhostlyCopy|Ghostly Copies], each of which is the result of having performed the crafting step on the original item. Allflame crafting cannot be performed on corrupted items, nor can it be used to corrupt things.

You can then choose one of these [GhostlyCopy|Ghostly Copies] to keep for yourself, effectively multiplying your currency use by the number of Copies created. Certain crafting steps will apply [Intangibility] however, which can limit the total Allflame crafting that can be done on a single item.

Mercenaries of Trarthus have arrived in Wraeclast and are searching for worthy Exiles to offer their services to, for a fee.

When encountering a Mercenary, you will be able to inspect all gear, skills and supports they have equipped. Then, you can choose to Duel them with one of three options.

You can Duel a Mercenary to Hire them, paying them a fee to have them accompany you throughout Wraeclast. You can have up to three Mercenaries Hired at once, two of which will wait in Reserve in Town or your Hideout.

You can select a piece of gear the Mercenary has equipped, and Duel them for that item. If you win, you get to take it for yourself!

Finally, you can Duel a Mercenary to Exile them, preventing Mercenaries of that type from appearing for ten further Encounters. Doing this is useful to try to find a particular kind of Mercenary in future Encounters.

Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts dealing damage in an area. Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.

Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

Slam the ground, unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Consume an Endurance Charge every third time you slam the ground with this skill. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.

Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground.
